EITHER (conj.):
(1) वा ॥॥॥॥॥वा (never at
the beginning of a clause),
e. I dissolve on the
summit of this mountain:
नगमूर्द्धनि विलीये वा,
Ki.;
(2) ॥॥॥॥।किंवा,
will touch e. his nails
or his arrow-heads:
तन्नखं किंवा तदिषुमुखं स्प्रष्टारः,
Vi.: v. Or.

EITHER (pro.): Ph.:
e. of two:
अन्यतरः (रा, रत्);
e. of three:
अन्यतमः (मा, मत्); “on e. cheek”:
कपोलयोः;
“on e. side”:
उभयतः: v. Both; not e.
v. Neither.
